nodes.label: graphify add <url> ingestion
nodes.rationale: Auto-detects URL type (YouTube/video, Twitter/X oEmbed, arXiv, PDF, image, generic webpage-to-markdown) and, after a successful save, automatically runs the --update pipeline so the new file is merged into the existing graph without a manual second step.

nodes.label: graphify --watch background watcher
nodes.rationale: Debounces file activity (default 3s) so a wave of parallel agent writes triggers one rebuild instead of one per file; code-only changes rebuild immediately via AST with no LLM cost, while doc/paper/image changes only flag needs_update for a manual --update since they need LLM semantic re-extraction.
